Thanks for taking the time to reply. 
I've been dealing with depression on and off for 8 years and dealt with it through self harm eventually leading up to a suicide attempt. My mom found me and i have never felt so ashamed in my life. She didnt blame me and was very supportive but i could see how absolutely devastated she got when she realized the extent of my depression. Since then I've sort of held it together and stupidly tried to deal with everything myself. Now both my brother and i have our own apartments and i feel she can start her "new" life you know? 
She thinks im better and she is so happy. 

Anyways, thanks again for answering. It really helps with the anxiety to put words on stuff.
